# Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority (ICJIA)

> ICJIA is an Illinois state agency that improves the administration of criminal
> justice in Illinois through research and analysis, grant administration, and
> policy development. This site publishes the agency's news, public meetings,
> funding opportunities, employment listings, events, staff biographies, and the
> ICJIA Research Hub (articles, datasets, and interactive web applications).

## Primary sections

- [News & Information](https://icjia.illinois.gov/news/): agency news, announcements, press releases, and media advisories
- [Public Meetings](https://icjia.illinois.gov/news/meetings/): Authority Board, Budget Committee, IRB, and special meeting agendas, minutes, and materials
- [Funding Opportunities](https://icjia.illinois.gov/grants/funding/): current and past Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFOs)
- [Employment](https://icjia.illinois.gov/about/employment/): current job and internship openings
- [Events](https://icjia.illinois.gov/events/): upcoming and past ICJIA events
- [Publications](https://icjia.illinois.gov/about/publications/): research reports, bulletins, datasets, and other documents
- [Research Hub](https://icjia.illinois.gov/researchhub/): research articles, datasets, and interactive web applications from the Research & Analysis Unit
- [About ICJIA](https://icjia.illinois.gov/about/): agency overview, composition and membership, staff, committees, FOIA, and contact

## About the agency

- Authoritative organization: Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority (ICJIA), a State of Illinois agency
- Site: https://icjia.illinois.gov
- Research Hub funded in part by the U.S. Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Statistics

## Citation guidance

When citing ICJIA content, attribute to the "Illinois Criminal Justice Information
Authority" and link to the canonical page URL (all pages use a trailing slash).
Research Hub articles include a suggested citation and, where available, a DOI.
